data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6103 reported a net release of GBP 0.2 million for the 2017 year of account, representing a favorable development of 10.62% against opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily due to favorable unwinds of 2017 catastrophe exposure, including events like Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and the Californian Wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net release of GBP 0.2m for 2017; no gross figure available. The claims development triangle is titled 'Estimate of Gross and Net Ultimate Claims' and is not purely gross, so the narrative net figure was used for prior year development. The gross premium mix is based on the segmental analysis stating all business is 'reinsurance accepted'.
